question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing striker, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing center midfielder, Eve is playing left back, Fred is playing sweeper, and Gertrude is playing left winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Fred trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) striker
(C) right midfielder
(D) center midfielder
(E) left back
(F) sweeper
(G) left winger
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: left midfielder, striker, right midfielder, center midfielder, left back, sweeper, left winger
1. Alice ↔ Gertrude: left winger, striker, right midfielder, center midfielder, left back, sweeper, left midfielder
2. Eve ↔ Dave: left winger, striker, right midfielder, left back, center midfielder, sweeper, left midfielder
3. Eve ↔ Claire: left winger, striker, center midfielder, left back, right midfielder, sweeper, left midfielder
4. Bob ↔ Claire: left winger, center midfielder, striker, left back, right midfielder, sweeper, left midfielder
5. Gertrude ↔ Claire: left winger, center midfielder, left midfielder, left back, right midfielder, sweeper, striker
6. Dave ↔ Claire: left winger, center midfielder, left back, left midfielder, right midfielder, sweeper, striker
7. Claire ↔ Fred: left winger, center midfielder, sweeper, left midfielder, right midfielder, left back, striker
Eve is playing right midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
